briefing: Commander, {PATRON} speaks for this station, and for every hull that trades out of {HERE}.
A gang has been taking ships on the lane. Their leader flies a Fer-de-Lance, and it runs with an Asp Mk II, a Krait, and a Mamba.
Find them near the mark and finish it. {HERE} pays on the gang's blood, not on its promises.

hunt.arrive: Clear the gang out near {TARGET}, and the station pays {PAY}
hunt.success: The gang is broken near {TARGET} — {PAY} is paid out
hunt.fail: No kill near {TARGET} in time, and {PAY} stays unpaid

dossier.lead: Word reaches her that {PATRON} at {WORLD} wants a word.

rumour.far: Word on the board says {PATRON} at {WORLD} is paying blood money for a gang on the lane.
rumour.near: {PATRON} sends word from {WORLD}: the gang still hunts the lane, and the bounty still stands.

dossier.news: {PATRON} has posted a bounty at {WORLD} for the gang working the trade lane.

story.opening: On day {DAY} she took a bounty at {WORLD} to clear a gang off the lane.

closing.complete: By day {DAY} the gang off {WORLD} was finished, and the bounty was paid.
closing.fail: By day {DAY} the gang off {WORLD} was still loose, and the bounty had lapsed.

hunt.targetDestroyed: Near {WORLD} on day {DAY}, she put the Fer-de-Lance and its gang down for good.
hunt.targetFled: Near {WORLD} on day {DAY}, the gang broke and its leader ran, but the lane was cleared.
hunt.targetEscaped: Near {WORLD} on day {DAY}, the Fer-de-Lance jumped clear, but its gang was finished.
hunt.failed: Near {WORLD} on day {DAY}, the gang slipped free before she could finish the job.

dossier.title: Clean the Trade Lane
